notes: Which replicated Fortnite classes count as a TOKENIFY chest, and how openings are counted.
A class is a chest candidate when its name contains 'chest' and it replicates the container fields
(bAlreadySearched / SearchingPawn). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the
class name without its path and without the trailing _C.
Bump 'version' whenever a rule changes: the tracker re-reads affected replays and the server keeps the
previous result for audit. A user's own correction is never overwritten by a re-read.
v2 (Fortnite 43.00): 'weapons' names what a player holds and marks the ones that can break several things
in one use ('area'). Area weapons never add chests by themselves: they only decide whether a chest that
vanished without any record is listed for review (ambiguous) or just counted as unobservable.
'TackyGoofiness' is the game's internal name for the stretching fruit power (abilities: stretch launch,
rocket, grab, falling kick), which players call the Gum-Gum Fruit. A weapon without a label is shown by its
internal name rather than a guessed one.
v2 also stops 'hammock' matching the ammo rule and plain cannons matching the loot cannon rule.
